Tools for analyzing, generating and manipulating wordlists.

children.title: PACK
children.description: A collection of utilities developed to aid in analysis of password lists in order to enhance password cracking through pattern detection of masks, rules, character-sets and other password characteristics.

children.title: Pipal
children.description: THE password analyser.

children.title: pcfg_cracker
